shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Full cross-level combat, senses, NPC travel, CE bridge (experimental), transit animations (§73), finished-art blueprints (§74, built untested), and a subsystem-health panel. Workshop 3776015553. Owed: Workshop smoke test, §74 verify, wall-mount column decision (§75), notes-paste confirm, §62.N/§70 verifies, upstream paste.

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity.

**⚠⚠ THE THIRTY-EIGHT RULES:** 1. CLAMP AT SELECTION (§29e/§46/§53/§56.4). 2. NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms` (§29c). 3. REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER: flood CELLS. 4. COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/ENGINE STACKS (§56.3). 5 (§48): A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 (§49): A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP INSTEAD OF AN ERROR. 7 (§52): THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD ON WHAT IS ON THE MAP. 8 (§52.6): A LOAD-TIME REPAIR PASS MUST NEVER RE-CREATE WHAT THE PLAYER DELIBERATELY REMOVED. 9 (§53): SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 (§54): A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 (§55): A CELL-LEVEL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN-LEVEL ACTION. 12 (§56a): A FOREIGN MOD'S MAP-SIZE SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT. 13 (§56g): NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 (§56m): BEFORE RELOCATING DATA, ASK WHAT IS ALREADY AT THE DESTINATION. 15 (§57i): ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST. 16 (§56o): COUNT THE FOREIGN MOD'S WRITE PATHS. 17 (§56q): A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX. 18 (§57a): NEVER EXONERATE A SUSPECT ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE. 19 (§57f): **`TicksGame` RESTARTS AT 0 EVERY NEW GAME.** 20 (§57g): MOVING WORK EARLIER TURNS ON EVERY GATE THAT ASKS "IS THIS MAP READY YET". 21 (§58): **THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL WITH THE CONTENT.** 22 (§59): **A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN IN IT.** 23 (§60): **AUDIT THE WEIGHTING, NOT THE SYMBOL.** 24 (§61a): **CLAMPING A VALUE WITHOUT CLAMPING ITS TARGET BUILDS AN OSCILLATOR.** 25 (§61b): **A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS AFTER THE OBJECT WAS ALREADY POSITIONED.** 26 (§61f): **EVERY READ OF THE MAP THE PLAYER CAN REACH MUST PASS THE SAME "IS IT DRAWN" GATE THE RENDERER USES.** 27 (§62c): **PREFER THE OPERATION EVERY HOST IS ALREADY FORCED TO HANDLE (SPAWN/DESPAWN) OVER THE ONE EACH HOST HANDLES ITS OWN WAY (FLICK).** 28 (§63a): **A PERMANENT FICTION INSTALLED FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS READ AS FACT BY EVERY OTHER ONE.** 29 (§0b): **REPORT OUTCOMES, NOT INTENTIONS.** 30 (§66d): **A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN, NOT A NUMBER.** 31 (§66f): **WHEN A GUARDED HANDOFF FAILS IN THE FIELD, MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE DECLINED.** 32 (§69a): **TURNING OFF A TICK TURNS OFF EVERY SERVICE THAT RODE ON IT.** 33 (§62k): **A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO.** 34 (§62l): **AN INVISIBLE THING IS ABSENT FROM EVERY SECTION LAYER, NOT JUST THE MAP MESH; the map mesh and each overlay are SEPARATE METHODS.** 35 (§62n): **MAKING A CLONED FOREIGN DEF VISIBLE ENTERS IT INTO EVERY FOREIGN LOOKUP THE HOST BUILT FROM ITS OWN AUTHORED LISTS - AND IT IS IN NONE OF THEM.** 36 (§70a): **WHEN WE SPAWN SOMETHING VANILLA NORMALLY SPAWNS, WE MUST RUN VANILLA'S OWN LEGALITY PREDICATE, NOT A SUMMARY OF IT.** 37 (§71a): **NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT BEFORE NAMING THE SYMPTOM. Read the engine's own handler for the transition you are predicting.** 38 (§73): **WHEN A SPRITE MUST APPEAR AWAY FROM ITS THING'S POSITION, THERE MAY BE NO DRAW CALL THERE TO PATCH - own the draw: all three DynamicDrawPhases at the target loc, veto the atlas blit, key every phase off ACTUAL state (stagger durations are stat-scaled and advisory).**

# 74. BLUEPRINT FINISHED-ART LOOK — BUILT (0w/0e), IN TREE, NOT TESTED, NOT PUBLISHED

**Symptom (user report):** blueprints, especially stairs, don't look like their finished texture.

**Three stacked causes, three fixes in `Source/V2/ABBlueprintLook.cs` + one XML edit:**
1. **Vanilla forces a blue wash in C#.** `ThingDefGenerator_Buildings.NewBlueprintDef_Thing` assigns `color = BlueprintColor` ((0.82,0.92,1.0) x 0.6 alpha) unconditionally in BOTH branches (Transparent branch for authored blueprintGraphicData = stairs family; EdgeDetect branch = columns). Unreachable from XML. ⚠ TIMING: HarmonyBoot is [StaticConstructorOnStartup] which runs AFTER GenerateImpliedDefs_PreResolve, so the generator CANNOT be patched - `ABBlueprintLook` static ctor instead MUTATES every generated blueprintDef of our buildables (filter: category Building + blueprintDef != null + designationCategory != null [excludes spike + carriers] + our packageId): fresh GraphicData CopyFrom(def.graphicData) (CopyFrom nulls cachedGraphic; also picks up the ladder's drawOffsets which the authored blueprintGraphicData blocks never carried), shadowData null, shader Transparent, color white x **BlueprintAlpha = 0.70** (internal const, one number to taste), renderQueue 2950, then reassigns BOTH `bp.graphicData` AND `bp.graphic` (already resolved by PostLoad's ExecuteWhenFinished, which runs before static ctors; self-healing in either order because any later resolve reads our graphicData). Rule 33 tripwire: warns if the pass matches zero defs. The XML blueprintGraphicData blocks stay as no-dll fallback.
2. **Stuff tint.** Links are stuffed; the BUILT thing draws stuff-colored, blueprints don't (Blueprint thing has no Stuff; stuffToUse is a side field). `Blueprint_ABBuild : Blueprint_Build` overrides DrawColor = `entityDefToBuild.GetColorForStuff(stuffToUse)` at BlueprintAlpha; `AB2_LinkBase` building.blueprintClass switched to it (save-compat: class comes from the def on load, no new scribe fields). Columns are costList-built, keep plain Blueprint_Build.
3. **Ghost never rotated.** `GhostUtility.GhostGraphicFor` IsDoor branch IGNORES useBlueprintGraphicAsGhost and returns uiIcon as non-rotating Graphic_Single (the old def-comment claim it worked was wrong). `ABGhostGraphicForLinks` prefix (gated on ABBandStairsExt) bypasses it: wraps blueprintDef.graphic in vanilla's own EdgeDetect + ghostCol treatment (keeps white/red validity feedback), cached per def x color like vanilla.

**Verify list = ledger 1d.** Possible follow-ups if user wants: expose BlueprintAlpha in mod settings; same treatment for install blueprints if anything ever becomes minifiable.

# 75. WALL-MOUNTED UTILITY RISER (user request: "column but wall-mounted like wall lamps") — DESIGN PHASE, NOTHING BUILT

Options presented (user rule 4): **A** = wall variant of each of the 4 typed columns (parity, architect clutter); **B** = power-only "wall riser" (closest wall-lamp analogy, cheapest: ~Steel 25 + 1 comp, work ~1200, Electricity research only) - RECOMMENDED FIRST; **C** = one combined all-networks "service chase" (fights §62's one-type-per-def identity: classifier, per-type gizmos, merge-only rules). Mechanics for any option: vanilla wall-attachment machinery (`building.isAttachment` + `PlaceWorker_WallAttachment`), riser sits in the walkable room-side cell, despawns with its wall (host wall needs `supportsWallAttachments` - mod-wall compat caveat). ⚠ THE REAL WORK ITEM: the freestanding column's **holdsRoof** is what lets ABSkySync resolve the up-cell as the connector; an attachment cannot hold roof, so up-cell resolution needs a second path (candidate: riser cell is under roof held by the host wall; carrier still goes in the cell above the riser's own cell). Contained in ABColumnNetworks/ABSkySync. Recommend NO requirement on the band above (columns require nothing above either). Art = USER-supplied via Nano Banana kit (wall-lamp-style rotation set); kit to be written once scope is picked.
